explanations: ImportAll opens each statement and closes it only on the path where the whole file was read. When the header is malformed (or the file is empty) the loop records the error and continues without closing the handle, so every bad statement leaks one descriptor until the process hits its limit. The fix closes the handle on that early-exit path too; the cleanest form is to move the per-file work into a helper that does `defer rc.Close()` right after a successful Open, so no later branch can forget it.
